official.status_note: The official program page carries a live 'Apply Now' registration link to the MoFA scholarship service form and describes the admission procedure (tests and interviews) as currently in operation.
official.tuition_coverage_note: FAQ answer on the official page: 'Yes, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs covers all tuition costs in accordance with the program's policies.'
benefits: Scholarship to study abroad for a Bachelor's degree at a MoFA-approved university
Enrollment in the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy's Post-Graduate Diploma in UAE Diplomacy and International Relations program after the Bachelor's degree
Joining the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and appointment to the diplomatic corps after fulfilling graduation requirements
eligibility: Must be UAE nationals (holders of UAE passports and family book)

Must be between 17 and 21 years old and have legal guardian approval; FAQ adds that previous-year high school graduates may apply provided the applicant is between 17 and 22 years old at the time of application
Must provide a certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior from the relevant official authorities in the UAE

High school diploma thresholds: General / General Technical / American / other systems 90% and above; Advanced / Advanced Technical / SABIS 85% and above; Elite / Advanced Science Program 80% and above
British System / IGCSE: five IGCSE/GCSE subjects with grade B or higher plus two AS/A Level subjects with grade C or higher
International Baccalaureate: IB Diploma with a minimum average of 30 points or higher
IELTS (Academic Module) score of 6.5 or above, or equivalent (FAQ: minimum 6.5 Academic IELTS or equivalent TOEFL)
Acceptance letter from a university approved by MoFA
Male applicants must provide a certificate of exemption or completion of national service
Must agree to study a third language, if required
Must agree to join the UAE diplomatic corps at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for a period equivalent to the number of academic years covered by the scholarship
Must agree to join Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy (AGDA) upon graduation
Must provide parental consent to join the scholarship program
requirements: Hold a direct academic acceptance, unconditional to other requirements, in a specific specialty, institution and country for the MoFA scholarship, indicating the program start and end dates and the total cost
Register through the MoFA scholarship service form and attach the required documents in PDF format upon registration
Complete the tests and interviews that form part of the admission procedure
Successfully pass the mandatory interview, which is required to complete the scholarship requirements
documents: Valid passport copy (including the last page showing the unified number)
Transcripts copy for grades Ten, Eleven and the first term of grade Twelve, attested by relevant entities as applicable
Direct academic acceptance showing the program start and end dates and the total cost
Medical examination certificate, on the form available in the application and certified by any government hospital or medical center within the UAE
National service status certificate for male students
Certificate from a local bank under the student's name indicating the IBAN (after obtaining final approval, if the applicant is accepted)
Parental approval for students under 22 years of age (according to the Personal Affairs Law)
English language certificates with scores for one of the accepted tests
Certificate of Good Conduct and Behavior
selection_criteria: The admission procedure includes a number of tests, interviews and additional conditions
The interview is a mandatory part of the admission process and must be passed successfully
High school result thresholds by stream system (90% / 85% / 80% as published)
English proficiency of IELTS Academic 6.5 or equivalent
coverage: All tuition costs, in accordance with the program's policies
application_method: Obtain an unconditional direct academic acceptance from a MoFA-approved university for a specific specialty, institution and country, showing programme start and end dates and the total cost
Prepare the required documents in PDF format
Register through the MoFA scholarship service form
Complete the tests and interviews that form part of the admission procedure, including the mandatory interview
Track application status through program notifications; final results are communicated by email or SMS
official.application_route: Register once through the MoFA scholarship service form (Apply Now on the official program page), uploading all required documents as PDFs, then sit the admission tests and mandatory interview.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must be UAE nationals (holders of UAE passports and family book).
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The specialization must meet the needs of the UAE diplomatic corps and be studied at a MoFA-approved university; the approved-list page publishes majors including Artificial Intelligence, Communication and Media Studies, Data Science, Economics, International Trade, Law, Political and International Studies, and Political Science across approved institutions in Canada, China, France, Germany, Japan, Korea, Singapore and the USA.
official.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides a scholarship program for outstanding Emirati students who wish to pursue their academic journey abroad at one of the world's top prestigious international universities, with the aim of specializing in fields that meet the needs of the UAE diplomatic corps and enriching it with qualified Emirati personnel.
official.region: United Arab Emirates (study abroad at MoFA-approved universities)
official.english_requirement: IELTS (Academic Module) score of 6.5 or above, or equivalent; the FAQ states a minimum score of 6.5 in Academic IELTS or an equivalent score in TOEFL.

verification.notes: Verified live on the official MoFA Scholarship Program page (overview, eligibility, required documents, student journey and 11-point FAQ) plus the official approved universities list; no monetary figure, stipend, living/travel allowance, deadline or duration is published anywhere on the ministry's pages.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a pipeline into the UAE diplomatic corps rather than an open study-abroad grant: you must already hold an unconditional offer from a university on the ministry's approved list before you can register through the online MoFA scholarship form. Tuition is covered under the programme's policies, but the ministry publishes no stipend, living allowance, housing or airfare funding, so budget personally for flights, rent, insurance and daily living costs in what are usually high-cost study destinations. There is no published deadline, yet the review takes 3 to 5 months and ends with tests and a mandatory interview, so align your plan with your target university's own intake dates rather than waiting on MOFA. Accepting the award commits you to a diplomatic-corps service period equal to the academic years funded and to enrolling at the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy after graduation.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Emirati nationals aged 17-22 with stream-qualifying high school results (80-90%+ by system) and IELTS Academic 6.5 who hold or can win an offer from an approved university in a diplomacy-relevant major and genuinely want a UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs career.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the unconditional acceptance letter first, since the application cannot proceed without it showing specialty, institution, country, start/end dates and total cost
Book IELTS Academic early and target above 6.5, as the certificate is a required document in the upload pack
Have the medical examination done on the ministry's form at a UAE government hospital or medical centre before submitting
Male applicants: obtain the national service completion or exemption certificate before applying
Assemble attested transcripts for grades 10, 11 and the first term of grade 12, plus passport (including unified-number page), Family Book, Emirates ID (both sides) and birth certificate
Prepare parental consent if under 22, and open a UAE bank account with an IBAN in your own name for the post-approval step
common_rejection_risks: Applying with a conditional offer or an offer from a university outside the approved list, which the FAQ excludes outright
Missing your stream's exact percentage threshold (90% / 85% / 80%) or the IGCSE/AS-Level/B-or-C or IB 30-point requirements
Failing the mandatory interview, which the ministry states must be passed to complete the scholarship requirements
Male applicants without the national service certificate or exemption
Incomplete or non-PDF document packs, or missing attestation on transcripts
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The ministry publishes no stipend, living allowance or travel funding: applicants should fund flights, student visa costs, housing, food, health insurance and everyday living costs themselves for the full duration of the degree.
document_audit: The passport copy must include the last page showing the unified number, and the Emirates ID must show both sides
The medical examination certificate must be on the ministry's form and certified by a government hospital or medical centre inside the UAE
The acceptance letter must state the specialty, institution, country, start and end dates and the total cost - a standard offer letter without these details is a common trap
Transcripts must be attested as applicable, and the bank IBAN certificate is only needed after final approval
alerts: The service obligation equals the number of academic years funded, followed by AGDA enrollment - this is a career commitment, not free study abroad
You cannot choose a university outside the approved list, so verify your target institution and major on the official list before applying anywhere
Changing major or country of study later requires informing the MoFA program officer and the cultural attaché in the country of study
Amending a submitted application means calling +971 80044444 so the existing application is removed and a new one submitted
Decisions take 3 to 5 months with updates only by email or SMS, so plan around your university intake deadlines separately
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One online submission through the MoFA scholarship service form with the full PDF document pack, then ministry tests and a mandatory interview, with the result sent by email or SMS after a 3-5 month review.
